main.description: A post in the feed (feed/posts). A Public post is stored in its author's repo, a Followers or Mutuals one in their app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for that tier; the AppView ignores one in self or interactions. For now the AppView accepts a post only when its embed is a #proposal naming a feed.segmentNameProposal in the author's own repo with the post's record key, and serves it only while that proposal is indexed; clients write one only by sharing a name proposal.

text.description: The author's own words, such as why they propose the name.

embed.description: What the post shares. An open union: later clients may add other kinds, which the AppView ignores until it knows them.

proposal.description: Shares a segment or dive site name proposal (segments/segment-names, dive-sites/site-names).

The app.activitytracker.feed.segmentNameProposal, in the post author's repo under the post's record key. A URI, not a strong ref: the post is written with the proposal, before its CID is known, and always shows the proposal's latest version.
